item.text: The file has three specimens per material and ten points per specimen. The measurements stay approximately linear across the recorded strain range, so I’ll fit one pooled stress–strain line per material and show individual specimens in the plot. I’ll report the fitted slope as modulus and include the fitted intercept as context.

item.text: Estimated pooled elastic moduli are 69.38 GPa for aluminum, 199.06 GPa for steel, and 116.56 GPa for titanium. The fit uses all measured points for each material; the results and method are documented in [analysis.md](/private/tmp/tmp8g9ti6eg/pete/projects/elastic-modulus/analysis.md), with the figure at [stress_strain_fits.svg](/private/tmp/tmp8g9ti6eg/pete/projects/elastic-modulus/stress_strain_fits.svg).
